Seasoned Peas
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, February 13, 2010 - 2:41pm

Ingredients




pound PEAS #10
1 teaspoon PEPPER BLACK 1 LB CN

Preparation

1 POUR OFF HALF THE LIQUID EXCEPT FOR BEANS IN TOMATO SAUCE, CREAM STYLE CORN, BLACKEYED PEAS, SAUERKRAUT, RED CABBAGE, AND TOMATOES. 2 PLACE IN STEAM-JACKETED KETTLE OR STOCK POT. 3 HEAT TO SIMMER. SIMMER ABOUT 10 MINUTES, STIRRING GENTLY. DO NOT BOIL. 4 PLACE IN SERVING PANS. GARNISH AS DESIRED. 5 NOTE:1. PREPARE VEGETABLES IN SMALL BATCHES TO PREVENT MUSHY, BROKEN, OR DISCOLORED VEGETABLES BECAUSE OF OVERCOOKING. 6 IN STEP 2, VEGETABLES (GREEN BEANS, LIMA BEANS, AND BLACKEYED PEAS) 7 MAY BE SEASONED WITH 1 LB (3 CUPS) DICED RAW BACON. COOK UNTIL CRISP; DRAIN. ADD TO VEGETABLES. SIMMER BLACKEYED PEAS 45 MINUTES. 8 IN STEP 2, VEGETABLES MAY BE SEASONED WITH 1 TO 2 TSP BLACK PEPPER. 9 IN STEP 4, 1 LB (2 CUPS) MELTED BUTTER OR MARGARINE MAY BE ADDED TO ASPARAGUS, GREEN OR LIMA BEANS, CARROTS, WHOLE KERNEL CORN, OKRA, ONIONS, SWEET OR WHITE POTATOES, OR SPINACH. 10 VEGETABLES MAY BE STEAMED. SEE GUIDELINES FOR STEAM COOKING VEGETABLES 11 FOR OTHER CAN SIZES, SEE RECIPE NO. A00500. 12 TO HEAT VACUUM PACKED WHOLE KERNEL CORN, ADD 2 CUPS WATER. 13 ONE NO. 8 SCOOP MAY BE USED. SEE RECIPE NO. A00400. 14 SERVING SIZE: 1/2 CUP
